sourceReview.reason: Rechecked 2026-11-12 coverage: TechFlow (https://www.techflowpost.com/en-US/newsletter/144418) attributes a roughly 5% Avalanche C-Chain tokenized-stock market share as of 2026-11-08 to The Block citing RWA.xyz, while WorldPing and other mirrors explicitly repeat The Block rather than independent reporting. A dated directly readable RWA.xyz primary dataset validating the exact denominator and share, or two independent reputable full-text investigations, was not verified. The original discovery link remains a Google News redirect. Hold for six hours pending primary data; do not present syndicated repeats as independent corroboration.
